long_biography.plain_text:
Thai businessman Vichai Srivaddhanaprabha helped give polo a national organisation in his home country. He founded the Thailand Polo Association with the aim of securing the sport’s inclusion in the Southeast Asian Games. In Britain, he served as president of Ham Polo Club, where he supported charity matches as well as the sport itself.

His giving in Leicester supported both medical facilities and research. He contributed towards a dedicated children’s hospital and, together with Leicester City Football Club, funded a child-health professorship at the city’s university. The first holder, neonatologist Elaine Boyle, was appointed to develop research supporting clinical care and community outreach.
